template: In Snipe-IT, check out the asset with asset tag {{v1}} (named '{{v2}}', at /hardware/5). Use the asset's Check Out action (the Checkin/Checkout button on the asset page or in the assets list). In the checkout form: select the user '{{v4}}' from the searchable 'Assigned To' / user dropdown (type it and actually select the matching option from the dropdown list — do not just type it), and set the Notes field to text that includes '{{v3}}' (for example: '{{v5}}'). Fill any other required fields (e.g. checkout date if required). Submit the checkout. Then verify by reopening the asset page and report: the asset tag, the name, who it is checked out to, and the note text shown on the asset page.

provenance.instruction: In Snipe-IT, check out the asset with asset tag BA-00005 (named 'fwsi26-n2 Bench Asset', at /hardware/5). Use the asset's Check Out action (the Checkin/Checkout button on the asset page or in the assets list). In the checkout form: select the user 'Bench Assignee' from the searchable 'Assigned To' / user dropdown (type it and actually select the matching option from the dropdown list — do not just type it), and set the Notes field to text that includes 'fwsi26-n2' (for example: 'Checked out for bench run fwsi26-n2'). Fill any other required fields (e.g. checkout date if required). Submit the checkout. Then verify by reopening the asset page and report: the asset tag, the name, who it is checked out to, and the note text shown on the asset page.
